verdict.rationale: Jev's core design is natively typed answers. Developers send state plus typed questions (Choice, Score, Noul) and get structured answers back: the selected option or score, per-option probabilities, and confidence. The Python and JS/TS SDKs expose these as typed questions and answers that code can use directly, with no parsing, and question inputs accept JSON structure. Missing for 10: arbitrary JSON-schema-constrained output (answers are limited to the three decision primitives, so free-form extraction into custom schemas is not covered), and independent hands-on corroboration of the typed-SDK consumption experience specifically.
